method: Quota sample from first rendered results page of each category; greedy title-character TF-IDF diversity plus 0.15 institution novelty bonus; deterministic shuffled tie order; five forced anchor courses.
limitations: Not a statistically representative sample of all Thai MOOC courses.
Candidate pool limited to first page per category (maximum 30).
All selected course pages label their level as beginner; no advanced labels inferred.
Subtopic diversity is a title-based heuristic, not a manually validated learning taxonomy.
Three source pages do not list learning outcomes; those fields are kept empty.
collection: Visible rendered browser pages; raw text snapshots retained locally under data/raw/browser_snapshots. No TLS verification bypass.
